title: Hurdle hints and answers for November 27, 2024
summary: Hints and answers to today's Hurdle all in one place.
content: If you like playing daily word games like Wordle , then Hurdle is a great game to add to your routine. There are five rounds to the game. The first round sees you trying to guess the word, with correct, misplaced, and incorrect letters shown in each guess. If you guess the correct answer, it'll take you to the next hurdle, providing the answer to the last hurdle as your first guess. This can give you several clues or none, depending on the words. For the final hurdle, every correct answer from previous hurdles is shown, with correct and misplaced letters clearly shown. An important note is that the number of times a letter is highlighted from previous guesses does necessarily indicate the number of times that letter appears in the final hurdle. SEE ALSO: Mahjong, Sudoku, free crossword, and more: Play games on Mashable SEE ALSO: NYT Connections hints today: Clues, answers for November 27, 2026 Where did Wordle come from? Originally created by engineer Josh Wardle as a gift for his partner, Wordle rapidly spread to become an international phenomenon, with thousands of people around the globe playing every day. Alternate Wordle versions created by fans also sprang up, including battle royale Squabble , music identification game Heardle , and variations like Dordle and Quordle that make you guess multiple words at once . Wordle eventually became so popular that it was purchased by the New York Times , and TikTok creators even livestream themselves playing . Are you also playing NYT Connections? See hints and answers for today's Connections . What's the best Wordle starting word? The best Wordle starting word is the one that speaks to you. But if you prefer to be strategic in your approach, we have a few ideas to help you pick a word that might help you find the solution faster. One tip is to select a word that includes at least two different vowels, plus some common consonants like S, T, R, or N. What happened to the Wordle archive? The entire archive of past Wordle puzzles was originally available for anyone to enjoy whenever they felt like it, but it was later taken down , with the website's creator stating it was done at the request of the New York Times . However, the New York Times then rolled out its own Wordle Archive , available only to NYT Games subscribers. Is Wordle getting harder? It might feel like Wordle is getting harder, but it actually isn't any more difficult than when it first began . You can turn on Wordle 's Hard Mode if you're after more of a challenge, though. title: Moon phase today: What the Moon will look like on November 27, 2026
summary: See the Moon phase expected for November 27, 2026 as well as when the next Full Moon is expected.
content: It's been a few nights since the Full Moon, and we're starting to see a little less of it illuminated. The Moon is still in its Waning Gibbous phase, with the bright portion gradually getting smaller each night as we head towards the Third Quarter. What is today's Moon phase? As of Friday, Nov. 27, the NASA's Daily Moon Guide tracker tells us the Moon is in the Waning Gibbous phase, with 90% of its surface visible. If you don't have any visual aids, you can still see the Mares Serenitatis, Kepler Crater, as well as the Tycho Crater. With binoculars, you'll also see the Gassendi Crater, the Clavius Crater, and the Apennine Mountains. And if you have a telescope, you'll get to see all this plus the Apollo 11 and 14, and 16 landing spots. When is the next Full Moon? In North America, the next Full Moon will take place on December 23. In other time zones it will fall on December 24. What are Moon phases? It takes around 29.5 days for the Moon to move through all its phases, according to NASA . Throughout this period, the Moon's position relative to Earth and the Sun determines how much of its illuminated surface we can see. Starting with a New Moon, the visible portion gradually increases until it reaches a Full Moon, before shrinking again as the cycle comes back around. The eight phases are: New Moon - The Moon is between Earth and the sun, so the side we see is dark (in other words, it's invisible to the eye). Waxing Crescent - A small sliver of light appears on the right side (Northern Hemisphere). First Quarter - Half of the Moon is lit on the right side. It looks like a half-Moon. Waxing Gibbous - More than half is lit up, but it's not quite full yet. Full Moon - The whole face of the Moon is illuminated and fully visible. Waning Gibbous - The Moon starts losing light on the right side. (Northern Hemisphere) Third Quarter (or Last Quarter) - Another half-Moon, but now the left side is lit. Waning Crescent - A thin sliver of light remains on the left side before going dark again.

title: Save $100 on the Apple Watch Series 12 for Black Friday 2026, a record-low price
summary: The new Apple Watch Series 12 is on sale for $299 during Amazon and Walmart's Black Friday sales. That's its biggest discount yet.
content: SAVE $100: As of Nov. 27, the new Apple Watch Series 12 is on sale for just $299 during Amazon and Walmart's Black Friday sales. That's 25% off its $399 list price, a record low. Last year's model only got a $60 discount for the holidays. Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 42mm) $299 at Amazon $399 Save $100 Get Deal at Amazon The new Apple Watch Series 12 is an impressive smartwatch. Take it from me: I just spent the past few weeks testing it for Mashable. It's only fair that it's getting an equally impressive Black Friday discount. Released just last month, the Series 12's centerpiece is a revamped Health Sensing System that can take heart rate readings in near-real time. Whereas last year's Series 11 captured heart rate data every five minutes, and only continuously during workouts, the Series 12 checks it every five seconds all the time . To quote my review, "These changes make the Series 12's heart rate data much more precise and detailed than before, and more useful for non-athletes." As of Nov. 27, the day before Black Friday, Amazon and Walmart have the Series 12 on sale for only $299. That's $100 off its usual sticker price of $399, and a 25% savings — its biggest discount yet. Frankly, I'm surprised it's so cheap: On Black Friday 2025, the Series 11 was only $60 off . While other Apple wearables are also on sale right now, this is easily the best Black Friday Apple Watch deal I've spotted so far. Note that Amazon's $299 deal only applies to the Series 12 variant with a light gold aluminum case and a sand sport band. As of this writing, it's up for grabs at Walmart in that colorway, plus dark bronze/olive and space gray/navy combinations. What else I liked about the Apple Watch Series 12 A step count widget! Finally! Credit: Haley Henschel / Mashable The Series 12 can produce a new "Readiness" recovery score that adjusts throughout the day based on your activity (or lack thereof). It also brings support for a step count widget, or "complication," which Apple Watch users had to jerry-rig on older models . The Series 12 charges faster than the Series 11 and lasts a little longer, too. In my testing, its battery reached the two-day mark without Low Power Mode enabled. Apple has equipped the Series 12 with some new AI-powered Audio Intelligence features, including a note-taking tool called Siri Recap , but I'm less enthused about them. Buy it for the health tracking improvements above all else. Still looking for more Black Friday deals?
